referral_rate_percent.title: Commission rate (%)
referral_rate_percent.description: Share of an invitee's spending or top-up credited to the inviter

referral_max_per_invitee.title: Commission cap per invitee ($)
referral_max_per_invitee.description: Total commission earned from one invitee; 0 means unlimited

referral_duration_days.title: Commission period (days)
referral_duration_days.description: Only spending within this many days after the invitee signs up counts; 0 means forever

checkin_timezone.title: Check-in time zone
checkin_timezone.description: Time zone that decides the check-in date, e.g. UTC or Asia/Shanghai
